newsitem.title: USA: US W. Coast crude falls with weak domestic market.
newsitem.headline: US W. Coast crude falls with weak domestic market.

text.p: U.S. West Coast crude oil prices fell Wednesday with a weak domestic crude market while local buying remained stagnant, traders said.
ARCO remained the only confirmed seller of Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude, the region's benchmark grade, with three cargoes sold in July to Northwest U.S. refiners on a formula basis.
Formula deals, which are based on monthly price averages gathered by news services, do not affect the spot price.
With the discount flat, outright prices for ANS crude oil fell with a 27-cent fall in WTI futures and weakness in cash prices. Line 63 barrels also eased in line with the NYMEX and cash
Kern River and Wilmington crudes -- California heavy grades -- were unchanged.
Foreign spot buying remained quiet, traders said.
